title: Flowers You Can Eat
paras: Welcome to our small cake museum. This room shows the work of a cake maker called Lila. She made flowers from sugar for forty years. In the [[middle|middle]] of the room is her work table. Her low [[chair|chair]] is beside it. The blue [[thing|thing]] on the table is a small flower box. She used it to carry her sugar flowers to shops.

Lila started work early. Her room was [[cool|cool]], so the sugar did not get too soft. She made each flower by hand. It looks [[easy|easy]] in the film on the wall, but one flower took twenty minutes. Watch her fingers make a small red rose. She would [[never|never]] put a flower in its box before it was dry. New workers came to [[study|study]] her way of making roses.

Our flower room opens every [[september|September]]. Please do not touch [[anything|anything]] on the old work table. You can make your own sugar flower at the new table near the door. A guide will help you. Then put it in your [[mouth|mouth]] and taste it. Your visit ends with something sweet!
zh: 欢迎来到我们的小小蛋糕博物馆。这个房间展示了一位名叫莉拉的蛋糕师的工作。她做了四十年的糖花。房间中央是她的工作台，旁边放着她的矮椅子。桌上那个蓝色的东西是一个小花盒。她过去用它把糖花送到店里。
莉拉很早就开始工作。她的工作间很凉爽，所以糖不会变得太软。每朵花都是她亲手做的。墙上播放的影片里，做花看起来很容易，但做一朵要花二十分钟。看看她的手指怎样做出一朵小红玫瑰。花没有干之前，她绝不会把它放进盒子里。新来的工人会来学习她做玫瑰的方法。
我们的糖花室每年九月开放。请不要触摸旧工作台上的任何物品。你可以在门边的新桌子上做自己的糖花。一位讲解员会帮助你。然后，把糖花放进嘴里尝一尝。你的参观就在这份甜蜜中结束！

q.s: Lila made the blue flower box herself.
q.why: 只说莉拉使用花盒，未说是谁制作的。

q.s: It took Lila five minutes to make one sugar flower.
q.why: 文中说制作一朵糖花要花二十分钟。

q.s: Visitors can make a sugar flower near the door.
q.why: 文中说访客可在门边的新桌子上做糖花。
